Thermal threshold temperature is runtime-adjusted (dynamic) rather than fixed, introducing feedback loop dependent on workload and control algorithm state

studio_assumptions: HotSpot thermal model adapted from reference 9 (Zhou et al. 2010) with vertical thermal coupling stronger than horizontal coupling (90% heat transferred vertically)
Silicon layer thickness 5–50 μm assumed for 3D-integrated circuits; processor spans >1 mm horizontally, enabling vertical heat path dominance assumption
Cache banks far from heatsink have priority for power gating due to thermal dissipation gradient in stacked layers
Leakage power follows exponential temperature dependence with technology-specific parameters (A, B, α, β, γ, δ); values not provided in paper
Shadow tag predictor estimates cache miss rate degradation; counter resets periodically to measure runtime miss rate within 3% allowable degradation threshold
Fuzzy membership functions designed via simulation: e(n) search range [0,3] °C, ΔT(n) search range [−1.5,1.5] °C/unit time, derived from HotSpot peak temperature and max rise rate
